name: PCIC 2021 real network alarm sources
summary: Original real network alarm tables with separate reference arrays. Candidate adapter; source clocks, observation windows and reference graph semantics require an audit.

availability.access: Public pinned archives; actual transfer and source audit pending

feature_dimensions.summary: Raw categorical fields and recorded clock strings; no analogue channels
feature_dimensions.counting: All source columns remain strings until a separate clock and schema audit. Source row is provenance, not an input feature.

attributes.name: source_row
attributes.description: Original Alarm.csv row index, excluding the header; retained without sorting or deduplication.

attributes.name: Original Alarm.csv fields
attributes.description: Original field names, ID tokens and clock text. No automatic datetime or future-label conversion.

notes: The pinned distribution contains Wireless and two Microwave archives. Download is opt-in and is excluded from bulk downloads.
The downloader stores tar.gz as an opaque file. The loader reads bounded members without filesystem extraction.
Reference arrays are never loaded by the alarm API; explicit numeric NPY loading disables pickle.
A repository-level MIT notice is present. Original competition conditions and the scope of that notice for data are not yet independently confirmed.
The adapter does not establish causal ground truth, topology direction, synchronized device clocks, physical onset or survival censoring.
citation: PCIC 2021 causal discovery competition, gcastle-hub dataset distribution; Qiao et al. (2023), Structural Hawkes Processes, IJCAI, doi:10.24963/ijcai.2023/633.
